entries.content: An artificial tropical island south of Japan. It has a futuristic city, with large parts floating on water only connected by bridges, and is home to the sport of Jet Battles.

Jet battles, or jet fights, are all-female water sport featuring high-speed jetski races taking place in round circuits between multiple Jet battle teams. Multiple pairs from different teams participate in a battle. The goal is to knock the enemy teams off their UMIs and be the last team standing.

A UMI machine, usually referred to as an UMI, is a futuristic high speed jetski used in jet battles. UMIs have an energy shield that protects them from enemy attacks and slowly depletes the more attacks have been absorbed.
KIRISHIMA Co Ltd. is one of many companies sponsoring a Jet Battle team and building UMI Machines. Their model used in Jet Battles is called EXEAL.

Dolphin is what Jet battle athletes are called. In a Jet Battle, Dolphins take the role of either Gunner or Rider. Dolphin are always women and the majority of them have large breasts, with an F-Cup being the average size.
A Rider is the Dolphin that drives the UMI during a Jet Battle. They are responsible for avoiding enemy attacks and following the race track. A rider is always paired with a gunner.
A Gunner is the Dolphin that fires the energy weapon during a Jet Battle. It is their job to knock the enemy Dolphins of their UMI machine.
Jet battle teams participate in Jet Battles and are owned by companies. They consist of 4 members, forming 2 pairs with each pair consisting of a Rider and a Gunner.

A weapon wielded by a Gunner during a Jet battle. It resembles a firearm such as a rifle, pistol or shotgun and shoots water. Hits from an energy weapon deplete an UMI's shield and can knock Dolphins of their UMI machine, but don't cause real harm.
